description:
Who are we?

SupportYourApp is a global Intelligent Support-as-a-Service leader, partnering with tech companies and industry leaders like MasterCard, Calm and MacPaw in 30+ countries since 2010 to deliver secure customer and technical support. We operate globally, supporting clients in 60 languages across diverse industries. So what if you had a chance to be a part of the world’s leading SaaS, software, or hardware solutions?

Join our community as a Technical SaaS Support Consultant today and thrive in a multicultural and multilingual environment while enjoying your home office. Unlock your potential by mastering new skills and achieving challenging goals in cooperation with our People First management approach. Excited? Let’s see what it takes.

What you will do:

  • Deliver outstanding technical support via email, phone, chat, the client's portal, and scheduled video calls (no camera required);
  • Respond to, troubleshoot, or escalate all incoming support requests, including technical issues, in a professional manner and according to Service Level Agreements (SLA);
  • Qualify, replicate, and resolve inbound tickets;
  • Identify, reproduce, and report bugs clearly to the Product and Development teams;
  • Follow up on any open bugs with the Product and Development teams, taking into account the client’s business impact;
  • Help customers use the platform successfully and achieve their business goals;
  • Gather customer feedback to qualify needs and suggest improvements to enhance the platform experience;
  • Collaborate with the Customer Implementation and Customer Success teams to achieve the best customer satisfaction by delivering a customer-focused experience;
  • Proactively contribute to the Help Center and internal tools;
  • Accurately document all customer interactions in the CRM system;
  • Stay up to date with platform updates, new policies, and industry trends.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • Excellent French and English skills (C1 for both spoken and written);
  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Support in SaaS or a Technical Support role supporting complex technical solutions is a must;
  • Good Excel skills, including VLOOKUP, reporting and data analysis;
  • Experience handling calls with customers;
  • Good knowledge of mobile device troubleshooting;
  • Experience supporting US strategic customers and handling escalations;
  • Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities and a strong interest in technology;
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt to the audience (tech-savvy or not);
  • Good interpersonal and organizational skills;
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment;
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in managing customer information;
  • Ability to work both in a team and independently, as required;
  • Proactive approach with a positive attitude and great team spirit;
  • Genuine passion for building customer relationships and providing world-class support for a complex product;
  • Personal laptop or computer (at least 8Gb of RAM) and a stable internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps–download and 40 Mbps–upload).

Will be a great plus:

  • Experience with Zendesk is a strong advantage;
  • Previous experience supporting customers via email, chat, and video calls.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Fixed schedule;
  • Inclusive international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;
  • Good bonuses for referring friends
  • Paid intensive training and probation;
  • Work-life balance;
  • Responsive management interested in your growth and long-lasting cooperation;
  • Greenhouse conditions for self-development.

*The items listed in this section may vary depending on the terms of your engagement. Certain benefits and conditions typically apply to employees; independent contractors may not be eligible for all of these. The specific terms, including compensation, benefits, and work conditions, will be clearly defined in your agreement if selected.

You can learn more about the company and its culture by visiting our official website and social pages on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

So if you're a proactive Support Specialist who thrives on solving problems, ensuring customer satisfaction, and delivering outstanding service, don't miss this opportunity and send us your CV in English to collaborate with us!

Over 1500+ specialists who already deliver exceptional customer experiences collaborating with SupportYourApp.

Know someone perfect for the role? Refer them and get rewarded!

We adhere to the principles of equal treatment of candidates and prohibit discrimination on any grounds protected by law.

Your personal data will be processed as described in the SupportYourApp Candidate Privacy Notice.
